fit_reason: Whole boat on trailer listed by a private seller; a bowrider we can detail.
findings: Light grayish soiling and dulling on the white vinyl seat backs and bolsters, most visible on the rear sunpad backrest and cockpit bench
Light scuffing and grime on the cockpit and walk-through floor
Black hull sides look reasonably glossy but show some dullness and light haze in the bright sun near the bow
Minor smudges on the white gelcoat around the transom seat and speaker panel
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Cobalt 24SD and it looks like a well kept boat. The white vinyl on the seat backs and the cockpit floor are showing some light soiling, and the dark hull sides could use a polish to really pop in photos. We do pre-sale interior and gelcoat polish details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
